verdict.rationale: Docs comprehensively describe multiple integration paths (hosted checkout, Payment Links, Mollie Components, build-your-own-checkout) and platform plugins for quick setup, suggesting a fast path to a working payment flow. However, there is no evidence of concrete copy-paste code snippets in specific programming languages (e.g., PHP, Node, Python, Ruby) or official SDK quick-starts, so the 'copy-paste in my language, under a day' claim is only partially substantiated. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK code samples, a documented quick-start tutorial with time-to-first-payment metrics, and independent developer reports confirming same-day integration.
